about.title: A construction company built on trust, craft and discipline.
about.subtitle: Scer-L/Construct Sarl is a full-service general contractor delivering commercial, residential, industrial and infrastructure projects across the region. We're family-founded, employee-owned, and proudly hands-on.
about.story_p1: Founded in 1998 with a single pickup truck and a four-person framing crew, Scer-L/Construct has grown into a multi-disciplinary general contractor — but the values haven't changed.
about.story_p2: We still believe construction is a craft. We hire and train master tradespeople, run our own self-perform teams, and treat every site like it has our name on it — because it does.
about.story_p3: Today, our 600+ employees deliver projects ranging from custom homes to airports, with the same belief that built our first project: do it right, do it safely, and do it on time.

safety.d: Zero-harm culture with daily toolbox talks and OSHA-leading incident rates.

trust.d: Transparent pricing, weekly reporting and no surprises at closeout.

craft.d: Master tradespeople and a dedicated QA/QC team on every site.

sustainable.d: LEED-accredited team and a default low-waste site programme.

milestones.1998: Founded as a 4-person residential framing crew.
milestones.2006: Completed our first commercial high-rise build.
milestones.2014: Expanded into infrastructure with the Coastal interchange.

about.employee_owned_desc: Since 2018, every employee with one year of tenure receives ownership in the company. Our crews aren't just working on your project — they own the outcome.
about.cta_title: Let's build the next one together.
about.cta_sub: From your first site visit to the final handover, you'll work with the same accountable team.
